decisions.reason: The address autocomplete web service is a low-cost extension of the firm's established data and web-service infrastructure and fits the announced platform direction, so management sees little reason to abandon what it has publicly launched.
The Austrian gas grid fee database took real investment to build and signals international expansion, so management will likely attribute slow uptake to market-entry effects and persist.
Peak load window determination is a regulated process close to the core offer that ties into calculation services, so continued investment is justified by the firm's process-based platform strategy.
The end-customer tariff database draws on the firm's long-built industry databases and is central to its market-data business, so management remains committed to it.
Custom web services are a flexible, project-based offering aligned with broader end-to-end service provision and cost little to keep available.
The postal code lookup service shares infrastructure with the address service and supports standardized data exchange, so management keeps it as part of its data-services portfolio.
